title: Portability T5b: cross-platform shell hygiene audit
problem: Python code across the apiary repo uses shell=True, Windows-only patterns, literal 'NUL' or '/dev/null' null-device references, raw string path concatenation, and implicit text encoding. These break when the repo is cloned to macOS or Linux, or run under a non-bash shell.
description:
Second phase of the portability epic (T5), follows T5a (settings.json paths and interpreter normalization).

DEPENDENCY: Do not start this phase until T5a's runner/* branch is merged to master. T5a may touch some of the same hook files and we want to avoid merge conflicts.

Scope of work (apply the rules from CLAUDE.md 'Portability' section to the whole repo):
1. Subprocess audit: every subprocess.run / Popen call must use list-form args, never shell=True, never '.exe' suffixes. Audit core/hooks/*.py, runner/*.py, scribe/*.py, harden/*.py, budgeter/*.py, scripts/*.py, and any other .py under the repo.
2. Null device audit: grep for literal 'NUL', 'nul', '/dev/null' in Python files; replace with os.devnull or subprocess.DEVNULL. (Caveat: string literals inside docs or CLAUDE.md are out of scope unless they are user-facing instructions — document-level guidance should also be made shell-agnostic where reasonable.)
3. Path hygiene: replace manual path concatenation ('foo' + '/' + 'bar', f-string joins with '/' or '') with pathlib.Path operations. Ensure Path() is used end-to-end, not str.
4. File I/O: every open() / read_text() / write_text() must pass explicit encoding='utf-8'. Add where missing.
5. Update CLAUDE.md Portability section: the current guidance says '/dev/null not NUL' which is bash-specific; rephrase to describe the os.devnull rule in a shell-agnostic way.
6. Smoke test: run --help (or equivalent) on every CLI tool in docs/reference/cli_lookup.py's index under Windows-bash, confirm none crash.

Definition of done:
- grep for 'shell=True' across .py files returns only documented exceptions (if any)
- grep for literal 'NUL', 'nul', '/dev/null' in .py files returns nothing
- All open() calls in repo .py files have explicit encoding='utf-8' (or binary mode)
- CLAUDE.md Portability section is shell-agnostic
- Smoke test passes on Windows-bash

Out of scope (deferred): bootstrap script + stable project key (T5c), PORTABILITY.md + fresh-VM validation (T5d).
scope: Repo-wide Python audit: core/hooks/, runner/, scribe/, harden/, budgeter/, scripts/, and any other .py files. Also CLAUDE.md (Portability section rewording). No changes to settings.json (that was T5a's scope).
context: Phase 2 of the portability epic split. Depends on T5a landing first. T5c (bootstrap + stable project key) and T5d (docs + VM validation) queued after this.
